item.title: Aruruu to Asobo!!
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Leaf
  • 発売日: 2004-04-28
  • スコア: 6.529999999999999/10 (18 人評価)
  • 日本語名: アルルゥとあそぼ！！
  • 英語名: Aruruu to Asobo!!

别名

  • Play with Aruruu!!

あらすじ

A fan disc of sorts for various Leaf games.

Includes:

  • Witsarunemitea Senki: Action game featuring characters from Utawarerumono

  • Leapon: Ponjan game where you can choose from six opponents: Eruruu, Aruruu, Takase Mizuki, Mikage Subaru, Kurihara Touko, and Kida Emiri

  • Guendina no Majo: Real-time strategy game that takes place after Natsumi’s route in Magical Antique

  • Routes Extra Mission: Two short scenarios that take place after the main story of Routes

  • Leaf no Tou (Leaf Battle Characters): 50 stage RPG with real-time elements, with playable characters from Magical Antique, Tasogare, Utawarerumono, and Routes

  • And other omake material

item.title: Tenshi no Inai 12-gatsu
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Leaf
  • 発売日: 2003-09-26
  • スコア: 7.19/10 (499 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 天使のいない12月
  • 英語名: Tenshi no Inai 12-gatsu

别名

  • Teninai

あらすじ

TenInai is about a senior high school boy with relationship problems; he’s got few friends and perhaps because of his bothersome kid sister, is averse to any steady relationship. That is, until he has a sexual encounter with Kurihara Touko. Touko, a classmate of his, is a sensitive, simple girl desperate to make an impression on others, and willingly offers herself to the protagonist. He runs away from a relationship; Touko clings to him hoping to find one. This unusual relationship soon leads them on a long soul-searching journey.

あらすじ

You are part of a special program in the Imperial Army of Japan. During WW2 you were a clone that were subject of tests and special mutations. Liquid were injected into you that helped you develop special powers, like better healing and vision. The most important of all, immortality. You will die eventually if you are exposed to limb/body damage beyond the rate of repair, but anyway you will stay young forever.

  • 日本語名: 初音のないしょ!!
  • 英語名: Hatsune no Naisho!!

あらすじ

Hatsune no Naishou is a collection of Leaf’s mini games that any Leaf’s fan should not miss. The CD contains several cute mini software including some mini games, screen saver, wallpaper, and CD player. The mini games packed in the CD include a mini action game called Heart By Heart with characters from To Heart, a mini RPG game called Leaf Fighting 97, To Heart Omake, and of course the adventure game Hastune no Naishou.

item.title: DR2 Night Janki
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Leaf
  • 発売日: 1995-02-24
  • スコア: 5.24/10 (10 人評価)
  • 日本語名: DR2ナイト雀鬼
  • 英語名: DR2 Night Janki

あらすじ

DR² Night Janki is a mahjong game with adult scenes. The game has two modes: “Story” and “Regular”. The story mode is set in a medieval castle, which is said to be ancient grounds for sorcery, but is currently controlled by the mysterious Rumira, who runs a mahjong club. The hero, a man named Ryuuji, decides to investigate the castle, and therefore has to defeat its inhabitants (all pretty young girls) in mahjong matches.
